events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: Video Killed The Radio Star
angles.copy: Remember the day music changed forever? On this day in 1981, MTV launched, kicking off with The Buggles' iconic track. The irony isn't lost on us.

events.title: Oasis released Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which became the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Britpop Debut
angles.copy: On this day in 1994, Oasis dropped their game-changing debut 'Definitely Maybe'. It wasn't just an album, it was a Britpop phenomenon. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the legendary Woodstock Festival began. Three days of peace, love, and iconic music that defined a generation. Which performance stands out for you?

events.title: Elvis Presley's death anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who we lost on this day in 1977. His legacy continues to shake up the world.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's death anniversary
events.blurb: Influential American rapper Tupac Shakur died on September 13, 1996, six days after a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: On this day in 1996, we lost a true icon, Tupac Shakur. His powerful lyrics and impact on hip-hop continue to resonate globally. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's death anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles released Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover became one of the most famous in history. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and a distinctive voice in British rock, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Mad for it, Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation and still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine' in the UK
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A message of peace that still resonates today.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the device that changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to 007 and over six decades of iconic cinema. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic peace activist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true icon of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, 'The Beatles', commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unveiled their ambitious double LP, 'The White Album'. A diverse collection of tracks that showcased their evolving sound. What's your top pick from it?
